blocks.content: Accurate longitude measurement became possible after the invention of the marine chronometer, which allowed sailors to compare local time with GMT.
Accurate longitude measurement became possible after the invention of the marine chronometer, which allowed sailors to compare local time with GMT.

items: The marine chronometer is the essential device invented for precise longitude determination.
Comparing local time against Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) is the fundamental method used to calculate longitude.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The invention of the marine chronometer enabled accurate measurement of longitude at sea.
Navigators determine longitude by comparing their local time with Greenwich Mean Time (GMT).
